title: Show HN: Make cursed fonts like Times New Bastard
title_zh: 展示 HN: 制作带诅咒的字体如 Times New Bastard

paragraphs.en: A foundry for bastard web fonts. Mix, stretch and / or squish them.
paragraphs.zh: 一个混血网页字体的铸造厂。 混合、拉伸和／或挤压它们。

sents.en: A foundry for bastard web fonts.
sents.zh: 一个混血网页字体的铸造厂。

sents.en: Mix, stretch and / or squish them.
sents.zh: 混合、拉伸和／或挤压它们。

paragraphs.en: Clicking THIS button will add ALL google fonts to the dropdowns.
paragraphs.zh: 点击此按钮将会把所有 Google 字体添加到下拉菜单中。

paragraphs.en: Some more websites to grab free fonts to play with: UNCUT , Velvetyne , Font Squirrel , FontSpace , DaFont .
paragraphs.zh: 一些可以获取免费字体来把玩的更多网站：UNCUT、Velvetyne、Font Squirrel、FontSpace、DaFont。

paragraphs.en: Every download is a normal OpenType font. The swap is a liga contextual substitution registered for every script, so browsers turn it on by default.
paragraphs.zh: 每次下载的都是普通的 OpenType 字体。 替换是为所有文种注册的 liga 上下文替换，因此浏览器默认会启用它。

sents.en: Every download is a normal OpenType font.
sents.zh: 每次下载的都是普通的 OpenType 字体。

sents.en: The swap is a liga contextual substitution registered for every script, so browsers turn it on by default.
sents.zh: 替换是为所有文种注册的 liga 上下文替换，因此浏览器默认会启用它。

paragraphs.en: It works anywhere OpenType text is shaped: browsers, design tools, print. If a font looks unchanged, check that ligatures aren't switched off in the app you're using.
paragraphs.zh: 它可在任何对 OpenType 文本进行排版的场景中工作：浏览器、设计工具、印刷。 如果字体看起来没有变化，请检查你所用应用中的连字功能是否被关闭了。

sents.en: It works anywhere OpenType text is shaped: browsers, design tools, print.
sents.zh: 它可在任何对 OpenType 文本进行排版的场景中工作：浏览器、设计工具、印刷。

sents.en: If a font looks unchanged, check that ligatures aren't switched off in the app you're using.
sents.zh: 如果字体看起来没有变化，请检查你所用应用中的连字功能是否被关闭了。

paragraphs.en: No. Everything runs locally in your browser with Pyodide and fontTools .
paragraphs.zh: 否。 所有内容均在您的浏览器中使用 Pyodide 和 fontTools 在本地运行。

sents.en: Everything runs locally in your browser with Pyodide and fontTools .
sents.zh: 所有内容均在您的浏览器中使用 Pyodide 和 fontTools 在本地运行。

paragraphs.en: Bastardica can make simple fonts feel a little, hmm, richer? Use Y-offset and scale effects to make glyphs align perfectly.
paragraphs.zh: Bastardica 能让简单的字体显得更，嗯，丰富一些？ 使用 Y 偏移和缩放效果可以让字形完美对齐。

sents.en: Bastardica can make simple fonts feel a little, hmm, richer?
sents.zh: Bastardica 能让简单的字体显得更，嗯，丰富一些？

sents.en: Use Y-offset and scale effects to make glyphs align perfectly.
sents.zh: 使用 Y 偏移和缩放效果可以让字形完美对齐。

paragraphs.en: When mixing 3 or more fonts, they will intersect (e.g. every 5th and every 7th will collide on every 35th). The first font wins. The stride won't break for either.
paragraphs.zh: 当混合使用 3 种或更多字体时，它们会相互交错（例如每 5 个和每 7 个会在第 35 个处发生碰撞）。第一个字体优先。 对两者而言，步进都不会中断。

sents.en: When mixing 3 or more fonts, they will intersect (e.g. every 5th and every 7th will collide on every 35th). The first font wins.
sents.zh: 当混合使用 3 种或更多字体时，它们会相互交错（例如每 5 个和每 7 个会在第 35 个处发生碰撞）。第一个字体优先。

sents.en: The stride won't break for either.
sents.zh: 对两者而言，步进都不会中断。

paragraphs.en: Use prime numbers for strides, so the mix-in fonts collide more rarely.
paragraphs.zh: 使用质数作为步长，使混合字体更少发生冲突。

paragraphs.en: Mixing two fonts produces a derivative work, so make sure to check licenses of source fonts if you plan to use a bastard font commercially. Bastardica adds no conditions of its own. A credit is appreciated, but optional.
paragraphs.zh: 混用两种字体会产生衍生作品，因此如果你计划将混合字体用于商业用途，请务必检查源字体的许可证。 Bastardica 本身不附加任何额外条件。 署名是加分项，但并非必须。
